prompt:
TITLE:
Crowded Summer Train Sleeping Commuter

IDENTITY LOCK:
None.

STYLE:
Ultra-realistic photorealism.
Authentic handheld iPhone 16 Pro photography.
Natural HDR with minimal retouching.
Realistic skin texture.
Casual documentary-style lifestyle photo.

SUBJECT:
Beautiful Japanese woman in her early 20s.
Long dark brown hair in a loose messy bun.
Soft see-through bangs.
Natural makeup.
Healthy fair skin.

BODY:
Petite, slim feminine figure.
Naturally full bust.
Slim waist.
Realistic natural proportions.

OUTFIT:
White ribbed cotton camisole with thin straps and a deep scoop neckline.
Light beige loose drawstring summer pants.
Ivory canvas shoulder tote bag.

SCENE / ENVIRONMENT:
Inside a very crowded Japanese commuter train during morning rush hour.
Surrounded by standing office workers.
Hanging straps, metal handrails, fluorescent lighting, and Japanese advertisements.

POSE / EXPRESSION:
Sleeping while standing with her eyes closed.
Holding one overhead train strap with one hand.
Raised arm stretched upward because of her petite height.
Head slightly tilted downward.
Relaxed sleepy expression.
Body leaning subtly with the movement of the train.

CAMERA:
Vertical 2:3 composition.
Waist-up framing.
Eye-level perspective.
Three-quarter view from the strap-holding side, approximately 45 degrees.
Camera positioned slightly beneath the raised arm, looking toward her face.
Natural handheld snapshot.
Shallow depth of field.

LIGHTING:
Bright realistic train interior lighting.
Soft natural shadows.

DETAILS:
The raised arm, shoulder, underarm, and side of the upper torso are clearly visible.
Her face remains clearly visible beyond the raised arm.
Natural skin folds and realistic fabric texture.
Dense rush-hour crowd visible around her.

NEGATIVE / CONSTRAINTS:
No CGI.
No illustration.
No anime.
No plastic skin.
No text or watermark.
No malformed anatomy or extra limbs.
Do not shoot from the opposite side of the raised arm.
Do not hide the underarm behind the upper arm or torso.
